title: ObjectDetected
description: On-node analytics detected an object in a registered stream and opened or continued a track. Inferred, so confidence is required. The track is the only handle on the object and it dies at the hour boundary.

track_ref.description: Track the detection belongs to. Scoped to one stream and one wall-clock UTC hour; not a person reference.

bbox.description: Bounding box in normalised frame coordinates, origin top-left.

x.description: Left edge as a fraction of frame width.

y.description: Top edge as a fraction of frame height.

w.description: Width as a fraction of frame width.

h.description: Height as a fraction of frame height.

provenance.description: How the fact was inferred. `confidence` is required: this event is produced by inference, and consumers MUST NOT treat it as measured.
